name: nano
description: Developed a high-performance URL shortener in Spring Boot and MySQL, optimized to handle massive traffic using sequential database indexing and time-based partitions. Secured the routing system with custom mathematical scrambling to prevent data scraping, and integrated an in-memory MaxMind geographic database to track real-time user locations across IPv4 and IPv6 networks.

name: Hostel Automation System
description: Built a hostel management platform that automates authentication, data management and analytics. Admins get a dashboard for student enrolment, bulk mailing and analytics; students get a feedback system; and a companion app lets wardens verify student identity at the gate.

name: Stock Heatmap
description: Built a heatmap of the Indian market's key indices, grouping constituents by sector and colouring them by daily performance. Data is scraped from a popular market site and laid out with CSS Flexbox, with one-click PNG export of market snapshots.
